tasks.label: Run Prince Portfolio (frontend + backend)
args: $python = (Get-Command python.exe).Source; $backend = Start-Process -FilePath $python -ArgumentList @('app.py') -WorkingDirectory 'C:\Users\user\OneDrive\Desktop\Prince_Portfolio\backend' -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru; $frontend = Start-Process -FilePath $python -ArgumentList @('-m','http.server','5173') -WorkingDirectory 'C:\Users\user\OneDrive\Desktop\Prince_Portfolio\frontend' -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru; $ready = $false; for ($attempt = 0; $attempt -lt 30; $attempt++) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; try { $api = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/health' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2; $site = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:5173/' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2; if ($api.StatusCode -eq 200 -and $site.StatusCode -eq 200) { $ready = $true; break } } catch {} }; if (-not $ready) { Stop-Process -Id $backend.Id -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Stop-Process -Id $frontend.Id -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; throw 'Portfolio servers did not become ready. Check Python dependencies and ports 5000/5173.' }; Write-Output 'Frontend: http://127.0.0.1:5173'; Write-Output 'Backend health: http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/health'; Write-Output "Backend PID: $($backend.Id); frontend PID: $($frontend.Id)"
